Name: Change your dinosaur into a Doodle guy because you can
Author: Gumcrazy
Description:
Does anyone need this? No

Are you going to swap your dinosaur for a tamagotchi looking fella anyways?
Also no. (but maybe.)

---------
Does the squats! Sits down just as often as the original!
watch it eat the stuff you leave out and pop out eggs sometimes!
Walks in a manner that I personally find hilarious!
---------

Direct Installation: (for Steam)
Go to your steam folder> Steamapps> Common> Stardew Valley> Content> Animals

Save your previous Dinosaur.xnb somewhere else first so you can go back to the original when you want,
then drag and drop this version and replace it with this one!

Downloads.Description: Replace your dino with a doodle guy, he loves you!
